resolution.note: All three outcomes already shipped in #1445 and proved by existing tests: test/hook/stop.test.ts (base environment broken, base-environment.log and base-run.log under .krn/runs/stop-check; real base worktree without node_modules), test/hook/stop-loop-limit.test.ts (last-refusal.txt), test/cli/lane-run-reused-note.test.ts and test/cli/lane-run.test.ts (reused worktree named in lane prompt). Pilot drain proof clause out of scope: operator credentials are down.

title: The Stop red-at-base check tells a broken base environment from a red test and saves its refusal
body: Evidence (2026-11-18 18:09): pilot proof drain .krn/runs/pilot/lanes/preflight-proof-3.log, attempt t-5sxsphp exit=73 after 1001 s, release 190e52f (docs-only fix 95cc455 included). The rerun reused worktree /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/pilot/lead/.krn/worktrees/t-5sxsphp, which still held commit bfe2153 from the earlier attempt: docs/notes/t-5sxsphp.md plus packages/seo/tests/cli/recovery-note.test.ts (a test the earlier lane added to satisfy the old test-first refusal). The Stop hook red-at-base check then reported recovery-note.test.ts failing, while the lane saw it pass in its worktree; the refusal text is not saved anywhere (.krn/runs/stop-loop holds only a fingerprint). Audit H3 (.krn/runs/audit/system-audit.md): the base run happens in a mkdtemp worktree that may lack node_modules.

Outcome: (1) the red-at-base check reports a base-environment failure (missing deps, setup error) as such, not as a red test on the lane commit; (2) the Stop refusal text and the base run output are saved under .krn/runs/ so a lane and the lead can read why; (3) a rerun that reuses a worktree from a failed attempt says so in the lane prompt or starts from the base, so a stale commit cannot carry a refusal into the next attempt.

Proof: a stop-hook test with a base worktree lacking node_modules yields the named base-environment outcome, not a red refusal; a test asserts the refusal file exists after a refusal; the pilot drain gets an attempt with a new test past the Stop hook.
